architecture.mechanism: Real-time monitoring of key vehicle parameters using OBD-II embedded sensors combined with machine learning anomaly detection
architecture.intervention: Deploy a reinforcement learning model on the idle-stop controller that continuously ingests OBD-II sensor data for engine load, throttle position, and vehicle speed to detect pre-stall torque anomalies and inhibit the idle-stop command when a soft stall pattern is predicted while stationary in traffic
architecture.expected_effect: The engine remains running during traffic stops unless a stable idle condition is confirmed by the ML model, eliminating uncommanded soft stalls without triggering warning lights
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle in stop-and-go traffic for 50 cycles with the ML-based idle-stop inhibition active; if any uncommanded stall occurs or a diagnostic trouble code is logged, the intervention fails
